categories.main_business_segments: Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc. primarily operates in the development and provision of industrial software and digital intelligent solutions for the mining industry, especially coal mining. Its main business includes the LongRuan GIS platform, intelligent mining industrial software, smart safety supervision, smart emergency systems, non-coal mining intelligent solutions, zero-carbon airport energy management, and AI spatial intelligence applications. The company also offers customized software, technical services, system integration, and hardware products related to mining and energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include its proprietary LongRuan GIS spatial information platform, cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), digital twin technology, industrial internet, and IoT integration. It develops software with a service-oriented architecture supporting 2D/3D GIS, temporal GIS, and cloud-native microservices. The company emphasizes autonomous R&D with patented innovations in spatial data modeling, intelligent mining control, disaster simulation, and AI-driven decision-making. Production methods focus on software development, system integration, and hardware manufacturing for mining automation and digitalization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are coal mining enterprises, government emergency management and safety supervision departments, research institutes, industrial parks, and high-risk industry enterprises. The company serves major coal mining groups in China, including 40+ of the top 50 coal enterprises and 46 national smart mining demonstration mines. It also targets non-coal mining sectors such as metal mining and energy management for zero-carbon airports. The geographic market is mainly China, with emerging international business in Russia and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Beijing and subsidiaries across key mining regions including Shanxi, Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Hebei, and Shaanxi. It has regional sales and service centers covering major coal-producing provinces such as Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, Xinjiang, and others. Internationally, it is expanding into Russia and African markets through direct sales and agency partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the mining industry supply chain. It focuses on software development, system integration, and providing digital intelligent solutions that enable mining operations, safety supervision, and energy management. The company also manufactures related hardware products for mining automation but does not engage in upstream raw material extraction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on continuous innovation in AI spatial intelligence, digital twin technology, cloud GIS platforms, and industrial internet applications tailored for mining. It invests heavily in R&D to develop advanced intelligent mining solutions, including autonomous mining, disaster simulation, and AI-driven decision support. Collaborations with Beijing University and other research institutes support its '6626' advanced intelligent mine construction project. The company aims to lead in domestic industrial software with a focus on autonomous, secure, and cloud-based platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of industrial software products, customized software development, technical services, system integration contracts, and hardware product sales. The company is transitioning from license-based sales to subscription models for its cloud GIS platform. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment income, and financial asset management. The sales model includes direct sales and partnerships with distributors for certain regions or customer segments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic intelligent mining software market, with a market penetration rate exceeding 85% in coal mining GIS installations and participation in 46 national smart mining demonstration mines. It competes with other domestic and international industrial software providers and system integrators in the mining and energy sectors. Its competitive advantages stem from proprietary GIS technology, comprehensive product suites, strong R&D capabilities, and strategic academic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 328.6 million, a 17% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 33 million, down 60.8%. Despite the decline, the company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 940 million and net assets of RMB 741 million. R&D investment increased to 15.86% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented strategy. Cash flow from operations turned positive with RMB 21.9 million, indicating improved collection and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc. emphasizes its fully自主研发 (independently developed) LongRuan GIS platform as the technological foundation, offering a comprehensive, integrated industrial software ecosystem tailored for intelligent mining. Its products provide high-precision, dynamic 2D/3D spatial data integration, digital twin capabilities, and AI-powered intelligent decision-making, enabling safer, more efficient, and greener mining operations.
